name: Production Python Foundations
blurb: Structure, types, validation, errors, logging, tests, async and a professional git flow — the base every later service is built on.

name: APIs and Backend Engineering
blurb: HTTP from memory and a FastAPI service with auth, rate limits, idempotency and tests, deployed to a real public URL.

name: LLM Engineering Fundamentals
blurb: Tokens, calls, streaming, structured output, tool calling and cost control — the resilient LLM layer under every project that follows.

name: Embeddings and RAG
blurb: Embeddings, chunking, vector search and grounded answers with citations, built by hand before any framework is allowed near it.

name: Evaluation
blurb: Gold sets, retrieval metrics, LLM judges and regression gates — the week that turns opinions about quality into numbers.

name: Agents and AI Workflows
blurb: Workflow patterns and a from-scratch agent loop with state, approval gates and evals, plus the judgment to choose between them.

name: Databases and System Design
blurb: Postgres, Redis, queues, workers and webhooks under your AI service, and the method for designing and defending such systems.

name: Reliability, Security and Observability
blurb: Tracing, resilience patterns, prompt injection defence, tenant isolation, containers and CI — the week that makes it trustworthy.

name: Capstone and AI Consulting Skills
blurb: Build and ship Athena while learning discovery, cost modelling, proposals and case craft, then package the whole quarter for hiring.
